newsitem.title: USA: Watson sees Royce buy accretive in 1997.
newsitem.headline: Watson sees Royce buy accretive in 1997.

text.p: Watson Pharmaceuticals Inc said on Thursday it expected its acquisition of Royce Laboratories Inc to add $0.01 to $0.03 a share to its earnings in 1997.

In a telephone conference call, Watson Chief Executive Officer Allen Chao said he saw the $0.01 to $0.03 a share accretion, assuming synergies of $2 million to $3 million in selling, general and administrative expenses.
Chao said he did not expect many savings on the manufacturing side because Watson would have to run both its and Royce's plants.
Earlier in the day, Watson said it had reached a definitive agreement to buy Royce for $7.25 a share.
